text: Hello! My name is Aziz. What is your name? Hello, Aziz. I am Sara. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too. Where are you from? I am from Samarkand, but I live in Tashkent now. Are you a student? Yes. I am twenty years old and I study English. Thank you for your time. See you soon!
